approval.reference: workbench/tasks/equity_index_futures_basis_monitor/DESIGN_REQUEST.md: user-supplied Goal G1 on 2026-11-03; Task definition only; no live Tushare or Calendar execution authorization

goal: For an explicitly resolved set of CFFEX equity-index futures families and an explicit inclusive date window, obtain the existing public annualized basis history once per family and deliver Run-scoped machine-readable data, a concise report and execution evidence without reimplementing contract, basis, annualization or coverage semantics.
scope: CFFEX IF/IH/IC/IM ordinary monthly equity-index futures and the published cffex_equity_index_basis_history public product only. Task version 1 defines the approved authority and the G2 implementation contract. The current G1 stage implements no runtime and performs no Tushare or Calendar request; no Dataset, endpoint, UI, scheduler or Research publication is created. Actual G2 execution requires separate user authorization.

basis_semantics.inheritance: Consume the public CFFEXEquityIndexBasisObservation fields verbatim. The Task does not recompute, filter, rename or add contract, slot, basis or annualization semantics.
basis_semantics.sign_convention: negative = 贴水 (discount); positive = 升水 (premium)
basis_semantics.annualization: Inherited from the shared authority: annualized_basis_pct = basis_pct * 365 / max(days_to_delist, 1). This is simple linear calendar-day annualization in percentage points; near-expiry values are highly sensitive; it is not an executable arbitrage yield or rolling-hold return.
limitations: Market price difference only; no fair value, prediction, trading advice, transaction-cost, dividend, financing or roll-strategy meaning.
All active CFFEX ordinary-monthly contracts in the public result are retained per observed day; no volume, open-interest, main-contract or liquidity filter.
Slot names are M0/M1/Q1/Q2 exactly; no alternate M1/M2 naming.

family_rules: Nonempty unique set of IF/IH/IC/IM or unambiguous documented aliases; family codes are case-insensitive and normalized to uppercase.
所有股指期货 and 全部股指期货 resolve to all four families in canonical order IF, IH, IC, IM.
Unknown, unsupported or ambiguous names must fail input_resolution; never guess from a partial name, contract code, index code or sibling family.
date_rules: Real YYYY-MM-DD calendar dates; inclusive at both ends; start_date <= end_date.
end_date must not be later than the execution date in Asia/Shanghai; a future end date is invalid.
The requested window is passed to each product call unchanged; no automatic expansion, contraction, trading-day snapping or holiday fill.
effective_start = max(start_date, family_listing_date) is product semantics and is recorded, not used to rewrite the request.
relative_time_rules: Every relative expression is resolved to absolute inclusive dates before any market request; the original phrase and resolution basis are frozen in the Run.
最近两周: 14 consecutive natural days ending at the resolved anchor, inclusive.
最近 N 个交易日: N CFFEX open dates ending at the resolved anchor, inclusive, using the published CFFEX calendar; never N natural days. The documented 最近十个交易日 is N=10 trading sessions, not 10 natural days.
Specified dates are preserved exactly; no snapping to a nearby trading day.

The default anchor is the latest CFFEX open date strictly before the execution date in Asia/Shanghai. This V1 rule does not assume that the current day's session or data is complete, because no owner publishes a session-completion fact.
An explicitly supplied anchor date is allowed if it is a CFFEX open date and not later than the execution date; it is recorded as user-supplied.
If the published calendar cannot prove the anchor or its coverage, input_resolution is BLOCKED; never infer from weekdays, price rows or pretrade_date.
freeze: Resolve and freeze all inputs before acquisition; persist the verbatim original_request and resolved_inputs in the Run.
No post-hoc change of family, date window, N or anchor after acquisition begins; a changed request needs a new Run.
input_contract.no_defaults: No default family, date window, anchor or N; missing inputs require explicit resolution.

coverage_semantics.requested_window: The exact inclusive [start_date, end_date] supplied by the user; never rewritten.
coverage_semantics.effective_window: [max(start_date, family_listing_date), end_date] per family; dates before listing are not missing observations.
coverage_semantics.observed_window: Unique trade_date values in the successful public result; first/last are actual observations, never requested bounds.
coverage_semantics.expected_sessions_source: data_lake.datasets.tushare_trade_calendar public Application Service, exchange=CFFEX, view=calendar, export_schema_version=1; filter is_open == 1 within the effective window.
coverage_semantics.product_success_boundary: A successful public product result proves a complete M0/M1/Q1/Q2 panel only on its actual observation dates. It does not prove that every expected CFFEX session in the requested window was observed.
states: verified_complete: calendar coverage is complete and the expected and observed trade-date sets match, with no unexpected observed dates.
verified_partial: calendar coverage is complete but expected dates are missing or unexpected observed dates exist.
unverified: calendar coverage, authorization or completeness cannot prove the expected sessions; no completeness claim may be made.
not_applicable: family failed or the effective window is empty.
coverage_semantics.recent_gap: If the latest expected CFFEX session in the requested window is absent from a successful family's observations, it must be reported explicitly.
coverage_semantics.coverage_status_rule: not_applicable if no requested family succeeded; verified_complete iff every requested family succeeded and is verified_complete; verified_partial iff every requested family succeeded and all are verified with at least one verified_partial; unverified iff every requested family succeeded and all are unverified; mixed otherwise.
coverage_semantics.overall_status: complete iff every requested family succeeds and every family coverage is verified_complete; partial if at least one family succeeds but the run is not complete; failed if no family succeeds. A partial or unverified run must never be marked complete.
coverage_semantics.verification: Prefer the existing published Calendar capability; preserve its exact semantics and do not redefine completeness. If verification is unavailable, mark unverified rather than inferring a calendar.

output_contract.basis_daily_ordering: trade_date ascending, then canonical family order IF/IH/IC/IM, then M0/M1/Q1/Q2, then contract_code ascending.
output_contract.basis_daily_values: Copy public observation values verbatim; one row per observed trade_date x family x contract; no filtering, derived indicator, rounding or recomputation; preserve signed zero.
report_sections: Query target, original request, resolved families, requested window, resolution anchor/basis, and per-family actual first/last observation dates.
Latest actual observation date per family and its M0/M1/Q1/Q2 annualized basis, contract code and days_to_delist; differing family dates must be explicitly identified as different sessions.
Coverage and failures: expected-session source/status, missing dates, recent gap, family failures, and exact overall/coverage status lines matching result.json.
Source identity, inherited basis and annualization formulas (attributed to the shared authority), percentage-point units and sign convention.
Limitations: no arbitrage/roll-return meaning, no chart, distribution, prediction, trading advice or backtest.
run_evidence: resolution.json: frozen raw/resolved inputs, resolution basis, calendar export/coverage evidence and execution intent/authorization reference.

acquisition evidence: lossless actual public result payloads (or an equivalent lossless artifact) per successful family, plus classified failures; sufficient to verify every CSV row and summary without re-invoking the product.
verification.json: CSV/result/report/acquisition consistency checks and artifact digests.
All three result files and evidence are registered as same-Run artifacts.
output_contract.storage: Run-scoped Workbench artifacts only; market data is never committed to Git and is not a Research publication or Dataset.

product_errors.invalid_request: Invalid request fields or dates; never repaired by changing the request.
product_errors.source_failure: Credential or client construction, Source invocation or Source range service failure; record a safe message.
product_errors.no_observations: No underlying observation in the effective interval; never interpret as zero basis.
product_errors.incomplete_panel: Missing, duplicate, conflicting or unusable facts prevent a complete panel; never delete or fill to pass.

failure_semantics.family_isolation: Each requested family is invoked independently. A failed family does not invalidate successful family results, but the run cannot be complete and basis_acquisition is FAIL.
prohibitions: Do not delete missing contracts, synthesize prices, auto-replace contracts, substitute another family or interpret failure as zero basis.
Do not truncate or expand the window, change N, snap dates or retry with different inputs to manufacture completeness.
Do not recompute basis or annualization; copy the public product values.
failure_semantics.partial_runs: Partial successes are preserved as Run artifacts with explicit failures, but result_delivery cannot PASS while any requested family failed; partial success is never a complete PASS.

required_inputs: Explicit nonempty unique CFFEX futures family set: IF, IH, IC or IM, or an unambiguous documented Chinese alias; 所有股指期货/全部股指期货 maps to all four; unknown or ambiguous names must fail.

Explicit inclusive start_date/end_date in YYYY-MM-DD, or a supported relative expression resolved to absolute dates before execution; start <= end; end_date must not be later than the execution date in Asia/Shanghai.

For relative expressions: a published CFFEX calendar basis and a resolved anchor (latest completed CFFEX trading day); record the original phrase, anchor rule, calendar source/coverage and execution instant; if the anchor cannot be established from published facts, stop.

Explicit execution intent for this Task version and, for actual acquisition, separate user authorization covering public product and Calendar data access; Task approval alone does not authorize market requests.
For G2: the verbatim original_request and frozen resolved_inputs before any market request; no post-hoc adjustment of family, window, N or anchor.
allowed_capabilities: G1: authority files, task.json and Markdown only; no runtime, Run, market data, Tushare request or Gate outcome.

G2 future, separately authorized: data_snapshot.products.cffex_equity_index_basis_history.run_cffex_equity_index_basis_history(CFFEXEquityIndexBasisHistoryRequest) exactly once per family; consume only CFFEXEquityIndexBasisHistoryResult and CFFEXEquityIndexBasisHistoryError.

G2 future: data_lake.datasets.tushare_trade_calendar public Application Service via create_service(), TradeCalendarRange(exchange="CFFEX", ...), coverage/ensure/export; only for anchor resolution and expected-session coverage; no direct trade_cal call, no cache repair and no calendar redefinition.
G2 future: workbench/run_store.py create, artifact, event, gate and read for same-Run evidence; do not modify the generic recorder.
G2 future: existing root Python environment and Run-scoped local filesystem outputs; no new package, service, database, endpoint, UI, scheduler or framework.
planning_constraints: Resolve and freeze every input before any market request; no default family, date, N or anchor; unknown or ambiguous names fail rather than guess.
Use only the published product API, one family per call; do not modify the product, add a parallel basis calculator, or import Capture, Source, Raw, credential or private internals.

Use the published CFFEX calendar capability only for anchor resolution and expected-session coverage; its semantics remain owned by its module; never infer a calendar from weekdays, price rows or pretrade_date.
Acquire each requested family independently; preserve successful family results and classify failures; never stop, substitute or synthesize to make a complete panel.
A successful product result does not prove every expected session was observed; verify coverage explicitly and mark unverified when proof is unavailable.
Persist outputs and evidence only as same-Run artifacts; never commit market data; never mix Run evidence with Research Publication or Dataset storage.
Actual Tushare or Calendar access requires separate execution authorization; Task approval alone authorizes no market request.
Any semantic change requires a new Task version and user approval; existing Runs and snapshots remain frozen.
expected_outputs: G1: Task authority files, catalog entry and G2 implementation contract only; no Run, market output or Gate outcome.

G2: result.json with task/version, task digest, run id, verbatim original request, resolved inputs, per-family status, requested versus actual observed ranges, source identity, coverage/limitations, failures/unfinished scope and a stable CSV reference.
G2: basis_daily.csv with the exact 11 columns, one row per observed trade_date x family x contract, deterministic order and verbatim public values; no filtering or derived indicators.
G2: REPORT.md with requested/actual ranges, per-family latest-session four-slot annualized basis and dates, coverage/failures, source/formula/units, near-expiry caveat and limitations.
G2: same-Run resolution, acquisition and delivery verification evidence, including lossless actual product results; Gate outcomes only from actual checks.
acceptance_criteria: A complete run or result_delivery PASS requires every requested family to return a successful public product result and every family coverage to be verified_complete; partial family or coverage outcomes are not complete.

CSV rows and result.json summaries match the lossless public product results exactly; no deleted missing contracts, synthetic prices, contract or family substitution, zero-fill, window truncation or expansion, slot renaming or recomputed basis/annualization.
Requested window, per-family effective window and actual observed window are distinct; the requested end date is never reported as the last observation.
Per-family latest observation dates are reported independently; differing dates are explicitly identified as different sessions.

Calendar unavailability or incompleteness yields unverified coverage and no completeness claim; relative inputs without a calendar anchor are BLOCKED; no weekday, price-row or pretrade_date inference.
All outputs and evidence belong to one Run; market data remains in ignored RunStore, never Git; no Research publication or new Dataset.

G1: task.json validates against the shared Task contract; approval reference is traceable; links and navigation resolve; existing historical_return_observation is unchanged; no runtime, live request or full-repo test.

gates.name: Input Resolution
gates.criteria: PASS iff the verbatim original request, resolved unique family set, absolute inclusive dates, resolution basis (original phrase, anchor rule, calendar source/coverage and execution instant) and execution intent are frozen in resolved_inputs and a same-Run evidence artifact; dates are real, start <= end, end is not in the future in Asia/Shanghai, any anchor used for a relative resolution is a CFFEX open date not later than the execution date, and every family is an explicitly supported or unambiguous alias-resolved IF/IH/IC/IM. FAIL if a supplied family is invalid, unsupported or ambiguous, a date is invalid, a relative anchor is not a CFFEX open date, the end date is in the future, or a required input is invalid. BLOCKED if relative resolution lacks a complete published CFFEX calendar or anchor, a required input is unresolved, or execution intent is not established; never guess.

gates.name: Basis Acquisition
gates.criteria: PASS iff every requested family was invoked through the published product API exactly once, returned a successful result, the separate execution authorization reference is recorded, and the Run preserves lossless actual results plus source_identity, actual first and last observation dates, observation counts, coverage status/evidence (including an explicit unverified reason) and any family-level failures. FAIL if any family returns a classified product error or the acquisition evidence is missing or inconsistent; successful families remain preserved. BLOCKED if input_resolution is not PASS, separate execution authorization is absent, or a prerequisite prevents an authorized attempt. No fabricated, zero-filled or substituted result.

gates.name: Result Delivery
gates.criteria: PASS iff result.json, basis_daily.csv and REPORT.md exist in the same Run, are mutually consistent and consistent with the acquisition evidence; every requested family succeeded and every family coverage is verified_complete against the published CFFEX calendar; the report shows per-family actual date ranges and latest sessions, source, inherited formula, units and near-expiry caveat; and no incomplete or unverified scope is presented as complete. FAIL if outputs are missing or inconsistent, coverage is verified_partial, slots or rows are inconsistent, or the report claims unsupported completeness. BLOCKED if basis_acquisition is not PASS or expected-session verification is unavailable (coverage unverified). When basis_acquisition PASS and both a known verified_partial family and an unverified family exist, FAIL takes precedence over BLOCKED.
